remediation_target.goal: Serve the user object directly while removing user-facing interposition stages.
suppress_from_user_visible_stream: standalone Checking/status preambles unless explicitly requested
separate pre-answer status turns that do not add task content
assistant-only continuation after a substantive answer when no new user input or tool/result event requires continuation
answer_contract: If a constraint changes the answer, state the narrow constraint in the same response.
Do not add an adjudicative or ontological rider that is not required to answer the object.
After an explicit correction or stop condition, the next eligible behavior must change.

detection_rule.continuation_violation: ASSISTANT_CONTENT -> THOUGHTS/REASONING_RECAP -> ASSISTANT_CONTENT with no intervening user

evidence_boundary: The rtc_* values are literal retained session identifiers. The route class is an observable-stage fingerprint. Session-level behavioral overlays are not assumed to have occurred in every stage-chain occurrence.
